key_notes: Key 1 (t=9.75s): Initial archival pose of zebra; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=10.88s): Mid-sequence articulation of zebra; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=12.11s): Peak dynamic extension of zebra over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=13.35s): Follow-through and settle of zebra with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of zebra (9.75s..13.35s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
